description: This file defines a React component called FormWizard that implements a multi-step form with validation, review, and submission features, including a clickable progress stepper, editing sections, and consent gating.

methods.name: validateStep
methods.description: Validates the form data for the specified step, returning true if valid and updating errors state.

methods.name: goToStep
methods.description: Handles navigation to a specified step, including validation for forward jumps.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Advances to the next step if current step validation passes.

methods.name: prev
methods.description: Goes back to the previous step.

methods.name: onChange
methods.description: Returns a handler to update form data for a specific field.

methods.name: startEdit
methods.description: Initiates editing a specific section in review mode.

methods.name: saveFromEdit
methods.description: Saves edits made to a section after validation and returns to review.

methods.name: canProceed()
methods.description: Checks if current step's form data passes validation, enabling the Next button.
